**Note 1:**  Laterality must be coded for frontal sinus (C312).

**Note 2:** TNM is not defined for this schema. If directly assigning Summary Stage 2000 (SS2000), use the *Accessory (Paranasal) Sinuses* chapter on page 134 of the [SS2000 on-line manual](https://seer.cancer.gov/tools/ssm/ssm2000/SSSM2000-122012.pdf#page=134).
